Here are the merged notes containing all distinct obligations and fines with their line citations:

### Obligations of the Supplier
* Hold available spare parts inventory for the service of the plant in Kiryat Gat (L184, L194).
* Any change in the scope of service must be made in writing and signed by both parties (L185, L195).
* Supplier's technician must arrive at the Ashdod warehouse within four hours for an urgent call, and within two days for a regular call (L186, L196).
* Keep secret all information received within the framework of the engagement (L186, L188).
* Coordinate in advance with the site manager any work at the Kiryat Gat plant that requires a shutdown (L189, L197).
* Appoint a single account manager to coordinate contact with the client (L191, L201).
* Perform a monthly maintenance visit at the logistics center in Holon and submit a report on the visit (L192, L202).
* Insure its employees with employers' liability insurance and third-party insurance (L197).

### Obligations of the Client
* (No direct obligations stated; however, the client holds the right to inspect service quality at any time with advance coordination) (L190, L200).

### Fines (Payable by the Supplier to the Client)
* Failure to document a service call in the system at the Ashdod warehouse: 12,500 NIS per case (L187).
* Leaving waste on-site after work at the Holon logistics center: 14,250 NIS per case (L193).
* Delay in responding to an urgent service call in the Tel Aviv offices: 16,000 NIS per case (L198).
